###    🚀 Features

- Add repository, homepage, bugs, and author fields to package.json  -  by @showlotus [<samp>(abeef)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/abeefab)
- Add GitHub Actions workflow for publishing to npm  -  by @showlotus [<samp>(aaa7e)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/aaa7e04)
- Add support for multiple vision providers and implement OpenAI-compatible and Claude providers  -  by @showlotus [<samp>(b3884)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/b38847b)
- Add concurrency utility for parallel image analysis  -  by @showlotus [<samp>(bae31)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/bae31c0)
- Introduce CLAUDE.md for plugin guidance and enhance image analysis capabilities with new provider integration  -  by @showlotus [<samp>(2dafe)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/2dafedb)
- 更新 AGENTS.md，优化工具执行流程，添加路径检查和调试信息  -  by @showlotus [<samp>(68ba9)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/68ba95d)

###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- Update package name in command and add npm version badge to README  -  by @showlotus [<samp>(316e8)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/316e8b9)
- Remove version specification for pnpm action in workflow  -  by @showlotus [<samp>(2bb44)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/2bb4466)
- Update publish workflow to improve permissions and streamline steps  -  by @showlotus [<samp>(6e370)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/6e37093)
- Correct model detection and optimize async I/O  -  by @showlotus [<samp>(12dbd)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/12dbdc5)
- Remove toolChoice injection entirely  -  by @vladysta [<samp>(1667e)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/1667e63)
- Use context.sessionID fallback when state.pendingSessionId is null  -  by @vladysta [<samp>(934a9)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/934a949)
- 黑名单精确匹配避免误伤 deepseek-v4-flash-vision，README 补充新视觉模型说明  -  by @showlotus [<samp>(46e30)</samp>](https://github.com/showlotus/opencode-image-vision/commit/46e309d)
